description: This file defines the MysqliManager class, a PHP class that extends MysqlManager to implement MySQL database operations using the mysqli extension. It handles database connections, query execution, result fetching, and error handling specific to mysqli.

classes.name: MysqliManager
classes.description: A driver class implementing MySQL database management using the mysqli extension, providing methods for queries, connection handling, error reporting, and configuration specific to mysqli.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Executes an SQL query, handling both string and array inputs, logs activity, measures execution time, and manages errors.

methods.name: getAffectedRowCount
methods.description: Returns the number of rows affected by the last query.

methods.name: getRowCount
methods.description: Returns the number of rows in a result set.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Closes the database connection and cleans up resources.

methods.name: getFieldsArray
methods.description: Retrieves an array of field names from a result set.

methods.name: fetchRow
methods.description: Fetches a single row from the result set as an associative array.

methods.name: quote
methods.description: Escapes a string for use in an SQL statement.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the database using provided or default configuration options, and sets character set and collation.

methods.name: lastDbError
methods.description: Returns the last error message from the mysqli connection.

methods.name: getDbInfo
methods.description: Retrieves information about the mysqli connection, such as version, host info, server info, and character set.

methods.name: valid
methods.description: Checks if the mysqli driver can be used in the current environment.

methods.name: compareVarDefs
methods.description: Compares two variable definitions (vardefs), with special handling for integer length differences based on MySQL version.
